verses.text: Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová, wach'chom wojtak to te tojol a pensar, palta in gana tzin telaj in b'a het'ok. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'anb'ej juntzanh tik t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk sb'eyb'al? ¿Tas yuj junk'olal yaj heb' anhej chukal sna'a?

Ha ach a b'onak heb', wach'nhej sk'ib' heb', icha junok te te' wach' sb'at sch'anhal yib', wach' sk'ib'i, syak'an sat, icha chi' yaj heb'. Anhej yet' sti' heb' syal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo spensar heb' najat yajeli.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak in. Tzila' jantak yajoch in pensar t'ayach. Ik'b'at juntzanh anima chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Tza sik'kanel heb', yik wach' ol cham heb' t'a jun k'uhal ayik ol miljokcham anima.

¿B'ak'inh ol och wa'an stakji yib'anhk'inal tik yet' stakji'el anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok' nok'? Hanheja' nok' much wan scham nok' yuj schukal heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik. Sna heb' to max il tastak sk'ulej heb', xin chi t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Tato maj ach tzak'wan a b'ey yet' heb' sb'ey t'a yok, ¿tas wal ol aj a lajb'an a b'ey yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej? Tato manh junk'olalok ajek' b'aj sekan, ¿tas ol aj a na'ani tato tzach ek' t'a skaltak swayumtakil stitak ha' Jordán?

Ijan spax ip, palta manto ojtakok to a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, haton heb' ayto uj a b'a yet'ok. Tz'awaj heb' skot heb' t'a a patik icha heb' pechum nok'. Wach'chom wach'nhej syutej lolon sb'a heb' t'ayach, manh ak'och heb' yipok a k'o'ol, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol waktejkan in chonhab' tik, ol in patikejel jun chonhab' to wik yaji. Ol wak'och in chonhab' xajanab'il tik wuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol.
Ha heb' in chonhab' wiktaxon yaj tik, icha junok nok' choj t'a kaltak te' tz'el yaw skoti, icha chi' syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin, yuj chi' tzin yajkanel heb'.
Ha in chonhab' tik, lajan wal icha junok nok' ch'akb'a ch'ok yilji, stzok'jicham nok' yuj juntzanhxo nok' yetch'akb'a'il. Kotokab' masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ul satel in chonhab' tik.

Tzijtum heb' yilumal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol satanel in chonhab' tik, ichato wan satanel te' uwa heb' awab'il wu'uj. Ol stek'em lat'an in munlajel heb'. Ha lum lum nib'ab'il wu'uj, takinh lum ol ajkan lum yuj heb'.
Kuseltakxonhej ol ajkan in chonhab' tik yuj heb', ichato ol ok' lum t'ayin. Masanil in chonhab' tik, kuseltakxonhej ol ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol na'an jab'ok yuj.

Masanil t'a tzalkixtak t'a tzinan lu'um, ol jawok heb' winh winak sateli, yujto a wespada a in Jehová in tik, a ol satanel masanil b'aj slajwik'och smakb'en in chonhab' tik. Manhxalaj junok mach junk'olal ol ajok.

Ix yawej ixim trigo heb', haxo te' k'i'ix ix k'ib' sk'exulok. Nab'anhej ix munlaj heb'. Ix lajwi'el yawb'en heb', k'ixwelalxo smolank'e jab'jab' sat yawb'en heb' chi', yuj wal yowal in k'ol t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Icha tik swal a in Jehová in tik yuj juntzanh nación te chuk t'a slak'anil Israel tik, to ix yik'ek' lum lum heb' ix wak' smakb'enej Israel in chonhab': Ol wik'el heb' t'a slu'um junjun, haxo heb' aj Judá ol wik'el heb' t'a skal heb'.
Ayik toxo ix wik'el juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol ok'xok in k'ol t'a heb', ol wik'an meltzaj heb' t'a slu'um yet' t'a schonhab' junjun.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix k'ayb'an in chonhab' yak'an sti' t'a sb'i Baal. Haxo ol ajok, tato ol sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al in chonhab' tik heb', ol slokan in b'i heb' t'a tas syala', tato icha chi' ol yal yaj heb' t'a skal heb' in chonhab' tik.
Tato manh ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swal jun, a in wal Jehová in swala' to ol in satel heb' icha stok'jik'eta junok te te' yet' sch'anhal yib', xchi Jehová.
